result.reasoning_summary: FW-SAAS-005 correctly implements bounded, inert application-disable proposal generation. The patch enforces all acceptance criteria: (1) only HIGH/UNTRUSTED_DATA/DRY_RUN/CORRELATE_ONLY correlations produce proposals; (2) tenant-matched target and policy refs with engaged kill switch are mandatory; (3) evidence audited before ticket consumption prevents replay; (4) output is immutable, inert, with no execution authority; (5) no provider contact, credentials, or network access. Single-use Action Ticket binding prevents replay (verified by test). Narrow scope, no regressions, defensive validation throughout. Immutable frozen dataclass ensures proposal cannot be modified. Test suite covers happy path, replay prevention, kill switch check, tenant/agent/policy mismatches, confidence validation, and audit failure. Minor gaps in parametrized coverage for correlation fields and regex validation are not blocking—core acceptance criteria fully met and verified.
